description: List webhook events, most recent first: id, app, type, status, attempt, destination status code, latency, timestamp. Summaries only, no request headers or body; anyhook_inspect reads one event's payload by the id from here. Uses your AnyHook account when connected, otherwise the local in-memory store. Shows what arrived in your webhook inbox while away and which deliveries need attention. To catch up across sessions, use since and page with nextCursor until null. Advance your saved time after reading all pages.

api_key.description: Legacy field, ignored. Connect with ANYHOOK_API_KEY in the stdio client configuration.

appSlug.description: Filter to a specific app slug (account mode).

cursor.description: For the next page of older events, pass nextCursor from the previous page and keep the same filters.

since.description: Include events received at or after this UTC timestamp. When resuming, overlap the last read time and deduplicate by event id.

status.description: Filter by status. Account mode: queued|success|retrying|failed|rejected|circuit_open|quota_exceeded. Local mode: received|forwarded|failed|retrying.

name: anyhook_events
title: Read recent webhook inbox events
